stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy proposes to run a walk-in clinic for a newly designated vaccine during a public health event. Which statements about what must be in place are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A practitioner standing prescription alone opens this pathway.
The Commissioner must determine that health care professionals will be insufficient.
A Commissioner order authorizing the administration removes any need for a prescription.
Administration must accord with the Commissioner's order as well as a practitioner instrument.
A designation of the vaccine by the Commissioner is required.

explanation.core_reasoning: 105 CMR 700.003(F) permits a duly licensed health care professional to possess and administer a vaccine DESIGNATED BY THE COMMISSIONER, PROVIDED the Commissioner determines that there are or will be insufficient health care professionals available for timely administration AND issues an order authorizing it. Option D misstates the pairing by treating the practitioner instrument as sufficient alongside the order without the prior determination and designation, which are the conditions the question asks about.

choice_analysis.A: The practitioner instrument alone does not open the pathway.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: the insufficiency determination is a stated condition.
choice_analysis.C: The order does not displace the practitioner order or prescription.
choice_analysis.D: The statement omits the determination and designation that gate the pathway.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: the vaccine must be one the Commissioner has designated.

related_facts: A student may act only under authorisation and supervision
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates treat the Commissioner order as a single switch that turns the whole pathway on.

reasoning_steps: List the conditions the regulation attaches to the pathway
Separate the designation and determination from the order
Note that a practitioner instrument is still required on top
